subject: Next steps: stakeholder map, procurement path, and PO timing
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@brightgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: stakeholder map, procurement path, and PO timing

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap so we’re aligned and to capture the actions you mentioned: 

- Economic buyer: Sophie Li (CFO) 
- Technical sponsor: Tom Baxter (Head of Security/Legal) 
- Procurement: Sophie’s team (procurement executes PO once legal signs off)

Key decision criteria you shared: latency under 120ms 95th, predictable monthly committed spend, and SOC2 evidence for onboarding.

Open items / next steps I have noted: 
1) Please confirm who in procurement will own the PO (name + email).
2) Tom — if you can flag which SOC2 artifacts you need, we’ll surface them (we have SOC2 Type II report + platform attestation).
3) Contract lead time: you mentioned a 2–3 week internal review after legal; can you confirm target PO date?

I’m attaching a short PO template that many of our customers use — happy to adapt to BrightGrid’s format. Also attaching our security checklist for Tom to skim.

Proposed internal plan (for Marissa/Jordan): I’ll start drafting a commercial summary and a clean SOW that aligns with their commit and expected region. Marissa, can you prepare a baseline pricing scenario for a 12-month reserved plan vs hosted usage?

If that looks right, I’ll follow up to Sophie and Tom with the attachments + ask for the procurement contact so we can loop them in.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: PO-template.xlsx (xlsx), BrightGrid-Security-Checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@brightgrid.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophie Li <sophie.li@brightgrid.com>, Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@brightgrid.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T18:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: stakeholder map, procurement path, and PO timing

Thanks Neha — this is helpful. Quick clarifications: 

- Procurement owner: Sophie asked that I loop in Maya Chen (maya.chen@brightgrid.com) — she handles vendor PO processing.
- Timeline: Sophie expects legal review to take ~7 business days; procurement usually issues PO within 3 business days after legal sign-off. So best-case PO around Jun 5, worst-case Jun 15 given other board priorities.
- SOC2: Tom — Tom noted he needs the SOC2 Type II report plus our encryption-at-rest architecture summary and a note on data retention (30/90 day options). He’s fine reviewing the checklist you attached, but asked for any short memo that summarizes where logs/audit trails are stored.

I’ve attached our internal procurement form that we sometimes send vendors — happy to take Redwood’s PO-template and swap into our system if that’s easier.

Appreciate Marissa and Jordan getting pricing. Once Sophie has numbers we’ll route through legal and procurement.

—Alex
Director of Product Ops | BrightGrid Inc
alex.rivera@brightgrid.com

Attachments: BrightGrid-Procurement-Form.docx (docx)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T19:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Next steps: stakeholder map, procurement path, and PO timing

Folks — forwarding Alex’s reply. TL;DR: procurement owner is Maya Chen, target PO window early–mid June, legal ≈ 7 business days. Tom needs SOC2 Type II + short memo on encryption & log retention.

Ask: Marissa — can you produce: 
  - 12-month reserved pricing (monthly committed)
  - Equivalent hosted usage estimate for first 6 months (tokens per month estimate comes from their current usage: ~1.2B tokens/month)
  - A brief note on standard SOW billing cadence (monthly invoicing vs milestone)

Jordan — once Marissa has those numbers, can you prepare a one-page customer commercial summary (no more than 1 page) I can send Sophie to accelerate procurement approvals? Aim for it to include the cost, SLA bullets, and quick security callouts.

I’ll draft the email to Sophie + Tom + Maya and include the attachments once we have the pricing.

Thanks —
Neha

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Li <sophie.li@brightgrid.com>, Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@brightgrid.com>, Maya Chen <maya.chen@brightgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Summary & attachments for procurement review — Redwood x BrightGrid (deal BG-2026-0417)

Sophie/Tom/Maya —

Appreciate you taking the time to coordinate. Attaching the SOC2 Type II report, our short encryption + logging memo, and a populated PO-template based on the procurement form Alex shared. Highlights: 

- Commercials: attached two pricing options (12-month reserved commit; pay-as-you-go hosted). Marissa included estimates based on the usage Alex shared.
- SLA: 99.9% uptime target for Dedicated with fallbacks to hosted; latency guidance included (95th <120ms for the suggested config).
- Security: SOC2 Type II attached; memo summarizes encryption-at-rest, key management, and audit log retention (default 90 days, options to extend).

Requested asks from your side to move forward: 
1) Maya — please confirm the PO contact and any vendor portal steps we should follow. If you prefer Redwood to submit the populated PO as a vendor invoice, we can do that.
2) Tom — please confirm whether the attached artifacts satisfy legal/security or if you need a short call.
3) Sophie — target PO date (best estimate) so we can line up capacity and start date.

If convenient, I propose a short 30-minute call with Sophie + Tom + Maya early next week to unblock legal questions and confirm PO logistics. I’ll leave scheduling to Maya but happy to propose times.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood.pdf (pdf), Encryption_Logging_Memo.pdf (pdf), PO-template-populated.xlsx (xlsx)
